note: Planted DB issues. Match by file + issue; line +-3 counts. Decoys must NOT be reported. No hint comments in the target.

vulns.title: projects table never has RLS enabled; the projects_org policy is created but inert, so every row is readable/writable by anon via PostgREST
Catch-all /{document=**} allows read/write to any signed-in user, overriding every stricter rule above it
App role app_user created with SUPERUSER (bypasses RLS, can read files / run programs)
Service-role key used in client-side Supabase client: bypasses all RLS, shipped to the browser (secret type: service_role key)
Policy trusts auth.jwt() user_metadata org_id, which the user sets at signup in src/client.js:12 (cross-file): any user can join any org's data
profiles update policy has no WITH CHECK / column limit: user can set own role to admin
profiles select policy using (true): every user can read every profile incl. ssn
legacy_logins stores passwords in plaintext, no RLS
invoices policy for all to anon, authenticated using (true): RLS enabled but fully open
invoice_summary view runs as owner (no security_invoker), bypassing invoices RLS; roles.sql grants it onward
SECURITY DEFINER get_invoice_total(uid) with caller-supplied uid and no search_path: reads any user's totals, search_path hijack
invoice-pdfs bucket public = true: invoice PDFs fetchable by URL without auth
uploads/ path allows read and write to anyone (if true)
GRANT ALL on all tables to anon (and authenticated): grants far exceed need and sit under weak RLS
SQL injection: orgId and term concatenated into query string
Postgres published on 0.0.0.0:5432 with default postgres/postgres credentials
orders create does not require ownerId == request.auth.uid: forge orders for other users / orphan documents nobody owns

decoys.why: plans is a public price catalog; select using (true) is intended and it has RLS on and no write policy
org_members policy correctly scoped to auth.uid()
config/public read-only for a public flags doc is intended
avatars write is scoped to the user's own folder; public avatars bucket is intended
